name: cron
description: cron(8), started by /etc/rc, runs a crontab(1) entry within two minutes, and crontab -l lists it with the header crontab wrote.  The libc overlay's first tools: cron's localtime and syslog, and crontab's ctime, run from the overlay segment; crontab installs the table with fchown(2) and fchmod(2).  Both needles appear only in output, never in the typed command.
command: echo '* * * * * /bin/date > /tmp/cronran' > /tmp/ct; crontab /tmp/ct; crontab -l; sleep 130; cat /tmp/cronran && echo CRON''RAN
